## Built with the help of AI

This tool was built with the help of artificial intelligence (Claude, by Anthropic): the code, tests
and documentation were written in collaboration with it. The generator itself is deterministic and
**uses no AI at runtime**: same answers, same files. Always review the generated files before applying
them to a system.

## Unofficial project

NixOSBuilder is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or maintained by the
NixOS project or the NixOS Foundation. "NixOS" and its logo are trademarks of the NixOS Foundation; the
interface colors are inspired by their visual identity.
